notes: Jonath-elem-rechokim, an instrument or a tune called "Dove of silence of those far away."
Psalms 56:3 3 What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

Psalms 57:1 1 ¶ TO the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave. Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until [these] calamities be overpast.
Al-taschith means "destroy not" and may identify the tune to accompany this psalm
This psalm was penned by David, when he fled from Saul in the cave; 1 Sam. 24
